model_family: Frozen pretrained Trackastra with supervised head or minimal LoRA adapters

literature_evidence.citation: Gallusser B, Weigert M. Trackastra: Transformer-based cell tracking for live-cell microscopy. ECCV 2024.
literature_evidence.reported_result: Trackastra learns pairwise associations from temporal detection windows and its general model remained highly competitive across evaluated cell-tracking datasets.
literature_evidence.task_relevance: Frozen pretrained temporal representations may supply cross-video ranking stability while limiting trainable parameters and local compute.

literature_evidence.citation: Lalit M et al. An Investigation of Unsupervised Cell Tracking and Interactive Fine-Tuning. ICCV 2025 BIC Workshop.
literature_evidence.reported_result: The work applies association-matrix objectives and low-rank adaptation to Trackastra in an interactive fine-tuning setting.
literature_evidence.task_relevance: It supports testing a frozen-head or parameter-efficient adaptation before spending the compute required for full transformer retraining.

hypothesis.observed_failure_mode: Small fit-only rankers fail to normalize association confidence consistently across videos and cell families.
hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: A pretrained general cell-tracking representation provides transferable association context; a supervised fit-only head or minimal adapters specialize it without full retraining.
hypothesis.falsification_test: The pinned zero-wrfeat checkpoint cleared the fit-only ranking-signal gate. Reject the next identity unless a grouped-OOF frozen-head candidate improves exact held-fit graph score by at least 0.005 over APNCC without raw-score or recall regression.

early_stop_conditions: Stop if the pinned checkpoint, source commit, BSD-3-Clause license, or asset hashes drift.
Stop on MPS instability or any memory, free-memory, or swap guard violation.
Stop if frozen-body throughput cannot fit a useful continuation inside seven hours.
Stop if grouped-OOF proposal precision is below 0.95 or any fold is below 0.93.
Stop before validation12 or CV57 unless exact held-fit graph scoring improves adjusted edge Jaccard by at least 0.005 with nonnegative raw delta and node-recall delta.
success_criteria: Grouped out-of-fold proposal precision is at least 0.95 and every fold is at least 0.93.
Exact held-fit graph adjusted edge Jaccard is at least 0.005 above APNCC, raw edge Jaccard does not regress, and node recall does not regress.
The frozen-head variant passes before validation12, CV57, or any LoRA adapters are enabled.
Artifact provenance pins the external checkpoint, license, fit split and trainable parameter set.
